Manages planning projects or processes, such as supply/demand balancing under constrained capacity, scenario planning, or safety stock optimization. Solves planning problems involving cross\-functional variables such as forecast accuracy, lead times, asset utilization, and market fluctuations, often deriving solutions from limited data or historical precedents. Regularly communicates with internal teams across procurement, operations, finance, and commercial, and may coordinate directly with external vendors, contract manufacturers, or key customers. These communications often require translating data\-driven insights into actionable plans while balancing risk, cost, and service objectives.

title: Amazon PPC Manager
description:
**About ProfitStory** 




 ProfitStory is an AI\-powered Amazon growth agency built by sellers, for sellers. We manage advertising, SEO and conversion for D2C and manufacturer brands on Amazon India and Amazon US, backed by MoneyBall — our proprietary AI that turns Brand Analytics, search\-term and campaign data into decisions, not dashboards. We're part of NVIDIA's Inception program, and we work on a results\-based model: we get paid when our clients grow. That means every campaign you run has real skin in the game.
 



  





**The role** 




 You'll own Amazon advertising for a portfolio of brands end to end — strategy, structure, bids, budgets and reporting. You're the person who knows why a campaign moved before the client asks, and you'll work alongside MoneyBall and our data team to move faster than a spreadsheet ever could.
 



  





**What you'll do** 



* Build and manage Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands and Sponsored Display campaigns across multiple client accounts
* Own bid and budget management against clear targets — ACoS, TACoS, and profit, not just spend
* Run search\-term and Search Query Performance analysis: harvest winners, cut waste, maintain negative\-keyword hygiene
* Design campaign structures that scale cleanly (keyword lifecycle, match\-type strategy, ranking vs. profit campaigns)
* Diagnose performance shifts and explain them in plain language to clients and internal teams
* Partner with our SEO, listing and creative teams so ads and organic work together
* Test new ad formats, placements and Amazon features early, and turn what works into playbooks
* Contribute feedback and use cases that make MoneyBall smarter



  





**What we're looking for** 



* 2\+ years hands\-on managing Amazon PPC, ideally across multiple accounts or brands
* Fluency in ACoS, TACoS, ROAS, CTR, CVR — and the judgment to know which one matters in a given situation
* Comfortable in Excel/Sheets with search\-term reports, bulk files and bid rules
* Experience with Amazon Brand Analytics, Search Query Performance, and campaign\-management tools
* Structured thinker who can defend a decision with data and change it when the data changes
* Clear written and verbal communication — you'll talk to founders and brand owners directly



  





**Nice to have** 



* Experience with Amazon DSP, Amazon Marketing Cloud or Sponsored TV
* Exposure to both Amazon.in and Amazon.com
* Amazon Ads certification
* Background in a seller or aggregator environment



  





**Why ProfitStory** 



* Work with AI tooling most agencies don't have — and help shape it
* Results\-based model means your wins are visible and rewarded
* Direct exposure to founders and brands scaling across India and the US
* Small, fast team in Coimbatore where your work isn't lost in layers

Role: Solution Architect – Semantic Governance AI Platform
   

 Engagement: Project / Contract / Strategic Collaboration
   

 Experience: 8\+ years preferred
   

 Domain: Enterprise Data Governance \| AI/ML \| Semantic Architecture \| Knowledge Graphs
   

 Location: Remote / Hybrid
   

  

 About the Project
   

  

 We are building an enterprise Semantic Governance AI Platform that establishes authoritative business definitions, manages semantic conflicts, maintains regulatory and decision provenance, and ensures approved definitions are consistently implemented across data warehouses, BI platforms, ML systems and enterprise applications.
   

  

 The platform will integrate with technologies such as Snowflake, Databricks, Power BI, Tableau, Collibra/Alation and enterprise data platforms.
   

  

 Role Overview
   

  

 We are looking for an experienced Solution Architect who can own the end\-to\-end technical architecture and work closely with business stakeholders, Data Governance teams, Data Scientists, Data Engineers and development teams.
   

  

 The architect will translate business governance requirements into a scalable architecture covering semantic modeling, workflow, AI, knowledge graphs, integrations, security, APIs and enterprise data platforms.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Architecture
   

  

 \* Design the end\-to\-end architecture for the Semantic Governance Platform.
   

 \* Define application, data, integration, semantic and AI architecture.
   

 \* Design the canonical semantic registry and concept/version model.
   

 \* Define architecture for ontology and knowledge\-graph components.
   

 \* Design workflow architecture for proposal, review, approval, escalation and deprecation.
   

 \* Define APIs and integration patterns for enterprise platforms.
   

  

 Data \& Semantic Architecture
   

  

 \* Design semantic models for business concepts, relationships, formulas and dependencies.
   

 \* Define metadata, lineage and provenance architecture.
   

 \* Design mechanisms for identifying conflicting definitions.
   

 \* Define semantic impact\-analysis architecture.
   

 \* Establish standards for canonical definitions and version management.
   

  

 AI Architecture
   

  

 \* Design AI/LLM components for:
   

 \* Semantic similarity
   

 \* Concept matching
   

 \* Conflict detection
   

 \* Regulatory document analysis
   

 \* Impact analysis
   

 \* AI\-assisted governance
   

 \* Define appropriate use of LLMs, embeddings, vector databases, RAG and knowledge graphs.
   

 \* Establish human\-in\-the\-loop controls so AI recommendations do not automatically become authoritative definitions.
   

 \* Define evaluation, explainability and guardrail mechanisms.
   

  

 Enterprise Integration
   

  

 Design integration patterns with:
   

  

 \* Snowflake
   

 \* Databricks
   

 \* Power BI
   

 \* Tableau
   

 \* Collibra / Alation
   

 \* Data catalogs
   

 \* Feature stores
   

 \* Enterprise APIs
   

 \* Existing Claims, Underwriting and Finance systems
   

  

 Security \& Compliance
   

  

 \* Design RBAC and fine\-grained access controls.
   

 \* Define authentication/authorization architecture.
   

 \* Design immutable/tamper\-evident audit architecture.
   

 \* Address encryption, secrets management and data protection.
   

 \* Ensure architecture supports enterprise security and compliance requirements.
   

  

 Technical Leadership
   

  

 \* Create HLD and LLD architecture documentation.
   

 \* Produce architecture diagrams using Draw.io, Lucidchart or Mermaid.
   

 \* Create API, integration and data\-flow specifications.
   

 \* Participate in technical discussions with client stakeholders.
   

 \* Guide engineering teams during implementation.
   

 \* Conduct architecture reviews and identify technical risks.
   

 \* Make technology and architectural trade\-off decisions.
   

  

 Required Technical Skills
   

  

 Must Have:
   

  

 \* 8\+ years of enterprise solution architecture experience.
   

 \* Strong experience with data platforms and enterprise integration.
   

 \* Strong understanding of Data Governance and Metadata Management.
   

 \* Experience with cloud architecture — AWS, Azure or GCP.
   

 \* Strong SQL and data architecture knowledge.
   

 \* REST APIs and event\-driven architecture.
   

 \* Experience with Snowflake and/or Databricks.
   

 \* Experience integrating BI platforms such as Power BI/Tableau.
   

 \* Understanding of ontology, semantic models or knowledge graphs.
   

 \* Strong understanding of AI/ML architecture and LLM\-based applications.
   

 \* Experience with security, RBAC and enterprise architecture patterns.
   

  

 Good to Have:
   

  

 \* Neo4j / Amazon Neptune / other graph databases.
   

 \* RAG and vector databases.
   

 \* Python.
   

 \* LangChain / LlamaIndex or equivalent frameworks.
   

 \* Collibra / Alation.
   

 \* Microsoft Purview.
   

 \* Data lineage platforms.
   

 \* Regulatory/compliance technology.
   

 \* Insurance, Banking, Financial Services or Risk domain experience.
   

  

 Expected Deliverables
   

  

 The Solution Architect will be responsible for producing:
   

  

 1\. End\-to\-End Solution Architecture
   

 2\. Architecture Decision Records (ADRs)
   

 3\. High\-Level Architecture (HLD)
   

 4\. Low\-Level Architecture (LLD)
   

 5\. Semantic/Knowledge Graph Architecture
   

 6\. AI/LLM Architecture
   

 7\. Integration Architecture
   

 8\. Security Architecture
   

 9\. API Architecture
   

 10\. Data Flow \& Sequence Diagrams
   

 11\. Deployment Architecture
   

 12\. Technology Selection \& Trade\-off Analysis
   

 13\. POC Architecture
   

 14\. Implementation Roadmap
   

 15\. Technical Standards for Engineering Teams
   

  

 Key Question We Expect the Architect to Solve
   

  

 The architect should be able to answer:
   

  

 How do we take an approved business definition such as “Loss Ratio”, represent it as a canonical semantic object, map it to regulatory requirements, detect conflicting implementations in Snowflake/Power BI/ML systems, perform impact analysis when the definition changes, and propagate the approved version across the enterprise — while keeping humans accountable for the final decision?
   

  

 Ideal Candidate
   

  

 We are looking for someone who can operate at both levels:
   

  

 Business → Architecture → Engineering
   

  

 and can confidently sit with:
   

  

 CDO / CFO / CRO → Data Governance → Enterprise Architects → Data Scientists → Data Engineers → Developers
   

  

 and convert the business requirement into an executable technical architecture.

This is a hands\-on engineering role. You will write
 **production code every day** 
 , and you will lead by building the hardest parts yourself.
 



 It is
 **not a management role** 
 . There is no team to administer, no appraisal cycle, no delivery meetings in place of engineering. If you have moved away from daily coding, this role will not suit you.
 



  





**Our Primary tech stack:** 



* React
* React Native
* Python
* Salesforce
* Cloud\-native, across all major clouds
* An agentic layer running through all of it
* Whatever else the client needs



  





**What you will own:** 



* **The build.** 
 Production code every week, on the parts that matter most. Design, write, review, ship.
* **Agentic systems.** 
 LLM\-driven features running in production for clients. Agents, tool calling, retrieval, evaluation, and the cost and latency behind each choice.
* **The technical standard.** 
 Design and code reviews for two or three engineers working alongside you.
* **Delivery.** 
 Scope, estimate, sequence and commitment date. When a date is at risk you raise it before it moves.
* **Technical discussions with clients.** 
 Requirements, trade\-offs, and what is possible by when.



  





**Requirements:** 



* 6–8 years in software engineering, hands\-on throughout
* Python, with production depth
* React, and React Native for mobile
* Cloud in production on AWS, Azure or GCP, deployed and operated by you
* Production code written in the last 90 days
* An LLM or agent feature you have built and shipped to production
* Experience leading engineers technically, through reviews, standards and design decisions
* Delivery ownership: you have carried a date and answered for it
* Able to work hybrid from Coimbatore



  





**Preferred:** 



* Both startup and large\-organisation experience
* Daily use of AI engineering tools such as Claude, Cursor or Copilot, with a clear view of where they help and where they mislead
* You follow the field closely and form views by building with new models and tooling rather than reading about them
* Salesforce
* Client\-facing experience, in India or abroad



  





**Process:** 




 Screening call, technical discussion, delivery and leadership conversation, offer. We aim to close within two weeks of first contact.

title: Senior Data Scientist
description:
**Measure Pharmaceutical Script Lift Through Healthcare Claims Analytics** 




  





 Move beyond campaign metrics and measure what happens at the prescription level. As a
 **Senior Data Scientist** 
 , you'll turn U.S. Rx/Dx claims, HCP data, causal inference, and AI into evidence of pharmaceutical campaign impact. Lead high\-value healthcare analytics globally and take your data science career further with Emapta.
 



  





**Your Career Snapshot** 




  




* Employment Type: Full\-time
* Shift: Night Shift, Weekends Off
* Work Setup: Work From Home



  





**Exciting Perks Await!** 




  




* Competitive package
* Medical life insurance
* Work from home arrangement
* Standard government and Emapta benefits
* Well\-equipped, modern, and accessible offices
* Employee engagement initiatives
* Mentorship and exposure to global leaders and teams
* Diverse, inclusive, and supportive culture
* Transparent performance management
* Unlimited upskilling through Emapta Academy courses (Want to know more? Visit:
 **https://emapta.com/training\-calendar/** 
 )



  





**The Qualifications We Seek** 




  





 Education \& Professional Experience
 



  




* **Master's degree in Data Science, Statistics, Biostatistics, Epidemiology, Health Economics, Computer Science, Mathematics, or a closely related quantitative field**
* **More than 5 years of hands\-on experience in healthcare data science, healthcare analytics, outcomes research, commercial analytics, or measurement, including direct ownership of complex analytical studies**
* Demonstrated experience analyzing U.S. prescription and medical claims data at the HCP and patient levels and measuring prescription lift, incremental impact, or related pharmaceutical outcomes
* Meaningful experience in pharmaceuticals, life sciences, healthcare media, real\-world evidence, market access, or healthcare consulting, with direct healthcare industry experience strongly preferred
* Strong knowledge of experimental and quasi\-experimental design, control\-group methodology, causal inference, statistical testing, bias reduction, and incremental impact measurement
* Advanced proficiency in
 **SQL and Python or R** 
 , with
 **experience managing large datasets and building reproducible analytical workflows**
* Practical experience using AI, machine learning, and generative AI tools to improve analytical productivity and expand insight generation, with sound judgment in validating outputs and applying them responsibly
* Ability to build new analytical capabilities from the ground up while personally performing the detailed technical work required to deliver results
* Excellent written and spoken English, with the ability to lead discussions, develop polished client\-facing narratives, and explain technical methods and findings clearly to non\-technical audiences
* Strong curiosity, ownership, commercial judgment, attention to detail, and commitment to producing accurate, defensible, and decision\-ready work
* Ability to work effectively in a remote environment, collaborate across functions and time zones, manage multiple concurrent studies, and meet client\-driven deadlines



  





 Technical Skills \& Platforms
 



  




* Advanced proficiency in
 **SQL and Python or R for data preparation, statistical analysis, causal inference, modeling, automation, and reproducible research**
* Strong
 **data visualization and business intelligence** 
 capabilities using
 **Tableau, Power BI, or a comparable platform, including the development of executive\- and client\-ready dashboards**
* Experience with
 **modern cloud data environments such as Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, AWS, Azure, or comparable platforms**
* Familiarity with
 **Git or another version\-control system, documented analytical pipelines, testing practices, and repeatable production workflows**
* Experience with
 **U.S. healthcare claims and prescribing\-data platforms or datasets such as IQVIA,** 
**Symphony Health, Komodo Health, PurpleLab, or comparable sources** 
 , strongly preferred
* Practical experience with machine learning frameworks, generative AI tools, and responsible AI\-assisted analytics, supported by strong human review and validation practices



  





**Your Daily Tasks** 




  





 Script\-Lift Study Design \& Execution
 



  




* Own the end\-to\-end design and execution of Rx/Dx claims\-based script\-lift studies across annual pharmaceutical campaigns
* Establish statistically sound study methodologies, including eligible HCP populations, pre\- and post\-campaign periods, exposed cohorts, holdout or matched control groups, attribution rules, confounder controls, and minimum sample requirements
* Identify high\-value HCP audiences at campaign onset based on prescribing history, diagnosis patterns, patient opportunity, specialty, engagement signals, and other relevant attributes
* Partner with Audience Intelligence and campaign teams to establish appropriate control populations and ensure activation aligns with approved study designs
* Measure outcomes, including new prescribers, incremental prescriptions, increased prescribing among existing writers, patient\-level opportunity, market share movement, and other agreed indicators of lift
* Apply causal\-inference and statistical techniques, including matched cohorts, propensity scoring, difference\-in\-differences, regression, significance testing, sensitivity analysis, and confidence intervals



  





 Data Management, Quality \& Governance
 



  




* Ingest, normalize, join, and analyze large healthcare datasets, including longitudinal Rx and Dx claims, HCP identifiers, audience profiles, campaign exposure, digital engagement, and program\-cost data
* Develop reusable code, analytical pipelines, data models, quality checks, documentation, and version\-controlled workflows to make studies accurate, efficient, auditable, and repeatable
* Validate data completeness, linkage, timeliness, coding, and cohort integrity
* Investigate anomalies and clearly document assumptions, exclusions, limitations, and potential sources of bias
* Protect sensitive healthcare and commercial data by following applicable privacy, security, data\-use, de\-identification, access\-control, and retention requirements
* Collaborate with internal teams and external data partners to resolve data gaps, improve identity matching, strengthen verified audience records, and enhance the reliability of measurement inputs



  





 Performance Insights, Storytelling \& ROI
 



  




* Produce quarterly measurement updates that explain audience quality, delivery, engagement, early prescribing signals, risks, and opportunities to improve campaign performance
* Deliver clear final analyses that quantify incremental impact and return on investment through transparent methodology and defensible conclusions
* Partner with campaign and audience teams to translate findings into specific optimizations that increase the likelihood of achieving the program's target of at least 3x ROI
* Create client\-ready visualizations, executive summaries, analytical narratives, and presentations that make complex findings understandable and actionable
* Distinguish correlation from causation, communicate confidence and limitations, and anticipate questions from clients, association partners, executives, and technical reviewers
* Build benchmarks across campaigns to identify the audiences, engagement patterns, messages, channels, and program designs most consistently associated with prescribing lift



  





 AI\-Enabled Analytics \& Capability Building
 



  




* Use artificial intelligence and machine learning to accelerate data exploration, coding, quality assurance, cohort development, anomaly detection, modeling, visualization, and narrative generation while preserving human validation and methodological rigor
* Evaluate and implement AI\-enabled approaches that provide additional analytical perspectives, surface plausible performance drivers, and improve the speed and consistency of recurring studies
* Establish reusable study templates, operating procedures, analytical standards, and reporting frameworks to scale script\-lift and outcomes measurement efficiently as the business grows
* Operate entrepreneurially within an emerging capability by identifying requirements, proposing practical solutions, testing approaches, making sound decisions with incomplete information, and driving work forward with limited oversight
* Maintain current knowledge of healthcare claims analytics, causal inference, measurement, machine learning, generative AI, and responsible AI practices and apply relevant advances to the program



  





 Cross\-Functional Leadership
 



  




* Serve as the analytical lead and primary subject\-matter expert on study design, claims\-based measurement, script lift, outcomes, and ROI methodology
* Partner with Audience Intelligence to translate analytical findings into audience selection, targeting, verification, and optimization strategies
* Collaborate with Data, Ad Operations, e\-Delivery, Product, Engineering, and Sales teams to define and operationalize required data, tools, workflows, dashboards, and campaign processes
* Communicate progress, findings, decisions, risks, and resource requirements proactively to the Director of Audience Intelligence and other stakeholders
* Contribute confidently to meetings across time zones and build strong working relationships with colleagues, clients, association partners, and external vendors



  





**About the Client** 




  





 Our client is
 **a healthcare media, technology, and marketing organization connecting medical associations, healthcare professionals, and life sciences brands through clinical content, data, and digital solutions.** 
 Their network reaches 3\.1 million verified healthcare professionals and supports hundreds of medical associations and health brands. They combine audience intelligence, AI\-powered segmentation, targeted advertising, medical education, specialty media, and performance measurement to help healthcare marketers reach relevant clinicians, understand engagement, demonstrate campaign impact, strengthen professional education, and ultimately support better healthcare outcomes.
